overview.name: Shrivarshaa Sakhamuri
overview.title: ML Engineer / Data Scientist
description: I like building things that move from **"interesting idea" to "actually useful."**

I'm an ML Engineer / Data Scientist focused on turning messy data into models, pipelines, and AI systems people can rely on from predictive analytics and computer vision to NLP, RAG, and production ML workflows.What I enjoy most is the space where experimentation meets engineering: figuring out what works, measuring it honestly, improving it, and turning it into something real.
When I'm not tuning models or debugging pipelines, I'm usually exploring a new tool, experimenting with an idea, or building something just because I'm curious to see if it works.

personal: Beyond engineering, I value continuous learning, curiosity, and building work that provides practical value. Outside work, I enjoy cooking, reading, working out, spending time with friends, watching series, and casual gaming.
